nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Indigenous knowledge in biodiversity conservation_qna_000
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What do the World Heritage Convention and the Convention on Biological Diversity acknowledge about Traditional Ecological Knowledge (TEK)?
nodes.answer: They acknowledge the importance of TEK in achieving the global conservation agenda.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Indigenous knowledge in biodiversity conservation_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How do Arctic food systems integrate traditional and modern influences?
nodes.answer: Arctic food systems blend Traditional Ecological Knowledge with modern, often energy-intensive influences, which have been triggered by colonization.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Indigenous knowledge in biodiversity conservation_qna_002
nodes.question: What is the main topic of the publication "Weaving Indigenous science, protocols and sustainability science"?
nodes.answer: The publication focuses on integrating Indigenous science and protocols with sustainability science to promote effective environmental management.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Indigenous knowledge in biodiversity conservation_qna_003
nodes.question: According to the article by Whyte et al. (2015), what are combined to enhance sustainability science?
nodes.answer: Indigenous science and protocols are woven together with sustainability science to enhance understanding and practices in environmental management.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Indigenous knowledge in biodiversity conservation_qna_004
nodes.question: How does the paragraph highlight Indigenous leadership in biodiversity management?
nodes.answer: The paragraph mentions efforts to improve Indigenous leadership and recognition in biodiversity management, indicating a focus on including Indigenous practices and knowledge in environmental conservation strategies.
